career_ladder.note: Governed by the Telangana Police Act, the Telangana Police (Subordinate Service) Rules, and Government of Telangana Home (Police) Department service orders. Constables in the District Police (Civil Cadre), Armed Reserve (AR), and Telangana State Special Police (TSSP / TGSP) advance through prescribed qualifying tests and seniority-cum-fitness rosters.

exam_scheme.note: Selection procedure involves three sequential stages: Stage I Preliminary Written Test (PWT) of 200 marks (screening only), Stage II Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET), and Stage III Final Written Examination (FWE). For Civil Constable (Post Code 21), Fire Fighter (26), and Warders (27/28), PET Run is qualifying, and merit is determined exclusively by FWE (200 marks). For AR (22), SAR CPL (23), and SPF (25), final selection is based on FWE (100 marks) + normalized PET Run marks (100 marks) = 200 marks total.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Preliminary Written Test (PWT) (Objective Type, Screening Only)
stages.source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 189/Rect./Rect.-2/2026 (Para 16-A & Annexure-II Syllabus)

papers.paper_name: Preliminary Written Test (200 Questions: English, Arithmetic, General Science, Indian History & Culture, Geography & Polity, Current Events, Reasoning / Mental Ability, Telangana State Specifics)
papers.negative_marking: 20% (1/5th) negative marks for each incorrect response
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30% for OC/EWS (60/200), 25% for BC (50/200), 20% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (40/200)

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
stages.source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 189/Rect./Rect.-2/2026 (Para 16-B & Annexure-I Gradation Table)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Men: 7 min 15 sec (Ex-Servicemen: 9 min 30 sec); Women: 5 min 20 sec (Scored out of 100 for AR/SAR CPL/SPF; qualifying for Civil/Fire/Warder)

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Field Events (Long Jump & Shot Put)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Height: Men 167.6 cm (Agency ST 160 cm), Women 152.5 cm (Agency ST 150 cm); Long Jump: Men 4.0m (Ex-SM 3.5m), Women 2.5m; Shot Put (7.26kg Men / 4kg Women): Men 6.0m, Women 4.0m

stages.source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 189/Rect./Rect.-2/2026 (Para 16-C & Annexure-III Syllabus)

papers.paper_name: Final Written Examination (200 Questions: English, Arithmetic, General Science, History of India & Culture, Geography, Polity & Economy, Current Events, Reasoning, Personality Test / Ethics / Social Awareness, Telangana State Contents)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking in FWE; deleted questions compensated proportionately
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (Max marks: 200 for Civil/Fire/Warder; 100 for AR/SAR CPL/SPF)

financial_package.note: Police Constables in Telangana are compensated under the Telangana Revised Pay Scales 2020 (RPS 2020), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.51, Finance (HRM.IV) Department, dated 11/06/2021. The post is placed in Scale 6 (₹24,280 – 72,850) with an Entry Basic Pay of ₹24,280. Dearness Allowance (DA) is calculated at the standardized project review constant of 58% effective 2025-07-01. House Rent Allowance (HRA) is governed by G.O.Ms.No.53 Finance Department (24% for Greater Hyderabad/Cyberabad/Rachakonda municipal areas, 13% for district headquarters/corporations, and 11% for other police stations).
financial_package.pay_source_label: TSLPRB Notification Rc No. 189/Rect./Rect.-2/2026 Para 1 & G.O.Ms.No.51 Finance (HRM.IV) Dept Dt.11/06/2021
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated on entry basic pay of ₹24,280 with 58% project constant DA (₹14,082), HRA ranging from 11% (₹2,671 in mofussil stations) to 24% (₹5,827 in GHMC Hyderabad/Cyberabad/Rachakonda), plus kit maintenance and police risk allowances (~₹1,500–₹2,500). In-hand estimate reflects statutory deductions: 10% NPS employee contribution on Basic+DA (₹3,836), Professional Tax (₹200), and TSGLI/GIS/EHS medical scheme deductions (~₹600–₹800).
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) indexed to AICPI as notified by Government of Telangana
House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 11%, 13%, or 24% of basic pay depending on posting station
Uniform allowance, kit maintenance allowance, and special risk compensatory allowance for field duties
Employee Health Scheme (EHS) cashless hospitalization across empanelled network hospitals
Telangana State Government Life Insurance (TSGLI) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) benefits
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching government contribution
Earned leave encashment, surrender leave, and festival advance as per Telangana State Service Rules
